AP phases A-C: 9 Pydantic models, PersonaStorage, 2 agents (suggester + generator), 2 HITL graphs, prompts. 187 AP tests

TD→GA→CE integration — 8-phase plan. ~44 new tests.
Daily Tracker DB persistence — 6-phase plan. 392 DT tests.

Structured Logging Layer 2 — Correlation & Context. 48 new tests.
Redis Infrastructure Foundation — core/redis.py (async+sync lazy singletons), settings, health check, DI. 13 tests.
RedisEventBus — Redis Streams SSE, atomic Lua INCR+XADD, EventBusProtocol, thread-safe mirror with eviction. 37 tests.
Pipeline State (Redis Hashes) + Distributed Locks. 36 tests.

Redis Approval Queues — BRPOP/LPUSH in DbTaskStore. 13 tests.
Redis Distributed Semaphore — atomic Lua acquire (Sorted Set). 11 tests.
6 critical Redis bug fixes. 17 new tests.
R2 Blob Storage Redis Cache Layer — CachedStorageBackend, mtime removal. 25 new tests.
Phase 5 StorageBackend Migration — Reader-side services migrated from direct filesystem.
Phase 6 Remove Filesystem Fallbacks — deleted JSON TaskStore, EventBus, JsonAuthService. ~1300 lines removed.
OpenRouter Phase 1 — Migrate 3 LLM wrappers to OpenRouter. ~32 call sites, 18 files, 386 tests passing.
OpenRouter Phase 2 — Migrate 4 direct SDK calls. 8 source + 3 test files. 1865 tests passing.
Frontend auth integration + security hardening. BFF proxy, httpOnly cookies, CSP nonces, 20 new files.
Integration readiness audit + 3 shared components (DateRangePicker, BrandLogo, SlideDrawer).
Brand Hub (/artifacts) fully integrated with backend API. KB, VSG, AP fetched from real endpoints. Version history dropdown. Upload modal. Auth login fixes. Dead code data loaders removed.

Query fanout generation (OpenRouter/Claude Sonnet, 6 intent axes, 12-18 variants per prompt). Self-referential FK on tracked_prompts. 30-day response text cleanup. 9 new API endpoints (fanout CRUD, answer history, cleanup). 394 DT tests passing.

Prompt tracking backend data layer — enriched prompt list (per-prompt mentionRate/citationRate/delta/sparkline/fanoutCount), per-prompt drawer analytics, 3 foundation bug fixes (N+1 query, days filter, _row_to_dict), 3 new composite indexes, 2 new endpoints, 6 new Pydantic models. 414 DT tests passing (20 new).

Prompt Tracking frontend-backend integration — 4-layer pattern (types/api/adapters/hooks). 8 new frontend files, 3 refactored components, 2 deleted mock files. Backend: start_date/end_date params on 3 endpoints. PB-95 (tenant isolation) added to backlog. 67 DT tests passing. Build clean.

Content Inventory Phase 1 Foundation — universal CMS-agnostic content registry. ContentInventoryModel (26 cols, pgvector embedding), Alembic 0026, ContentInventoryRepository (upsert/bulk/similarity/pagination), ContentInventoryService (5 ingestion + 3 similarity methods), URL normalization, 3 Pydantic DTOs, DI wiring, CMS FK. 67 new tests (39 unit + 14 service + 14 DB). 1623 existing tests passing.

Prompt Tracking full frontend integration + Brand Hub regeneration. Add Prompt modal (POST /prompts), Run All Prompts (POST /runs with persistent status banner, localStorage, polling), fanout generation animation (shimmer + polling), auto-run daily checkbox. Brand Hub: Re-generate buttons wired for KB/AP/VSG (auto-approve), Re-run Pipeline button calls Research Orchestrator (KB→AP→VSG DAG, auto-approve all). Two-pass competitor extraction: Haiku extracts structured JSON from KB markdown, daily tracker auto-resolves competitors from KB sidecar. PB-95 (tenant isolation) CRITICAL. 16 new extraction tests. Model fix (claude-haiku-4.5). LangSmith tracing on extraction. 683 tests passing.

Settings page (/settings) frontend-backend integration. Team tab: real API (member list, role updates superuser-gated, invite code generation). Integrations tab: WordPress CMS connect/disconnect via modal form, GA4 Analytics full OAuth flow (authorize → Google consent → BFF callback → property selection → sync → disconnect w/ purge). BFF callback route bypasses catch-all proxy auth. api.del() enhanced with params. Role mapping layer (superuser↔Admin, member↔Editor, viewer↔Viewer). Models/Billing/Notifications tabs remain dummy. 8 new files, 3 modified. TypeScript clean, build clean.

Content Planner (/planner) frontend-backend integration. 4 new backend endpoints (summary, assignments CRUD, custom create). TopicAssignmentStatus enum expanded (approved/rejected). Frontend: _lib/ (types, api, adapters) + usePlannerData hook + component updates. Initiatives sidebar stays dummy. 59 new tests. GA4 OAuth redirect fix. GA4 disconnect reconnect bug fix (active_only=False). Expand Topic button on Cluster Explorer.

Eliminate JSON filesystem from Topic Discovery pipelines — DB-only storage. New db_ops.py (13 async functions replacing TopicDiscoveryStorage). Pipeline A & B rewritten. DbTopicDiscoveryDataService JSON fallback removed. TD→Content orchestrator reads from DB. Router/guard uses DB queries. pipeline_state.json writes conditional on Redis. Migration 0029 (scoring_json, persona_affinity_index_json). 1588 tests passing.

Refactor topic expansion (Pipeline B) to additive per-subdomain DB upserts. 5 new db_ops functions (claim, mark, write-per-subdomain, rebuild-tree-json, reset-stale). Pipeline B rewritten: per-subdomain expand+persist with retry/backoff, circuit breaker, crash recovery. Per-assignment persona affinity scoring. db_read_taxonomy fallback for NULL tree_json. allow_parallel=True for concurrent expansions (DB optimistic lock replaces Redis slug lock). 3 tree CRUD API endpoints. Frontend: persona affinity in cluster header, target persona in drawer, auto-refresh via task polling, concurrent expansion support. Migration 0031. 18 new tests. 647 TD+API tests passing.

Content Studio stage-status enum resolution. Replaced 8-value ContentStage + 3-value Column with 17-value BriefPipelineStatus (mirrors backend) + 4-value KanbanColumn. New _lib/status-adapter.ts with pure mapping functions (getColumn, getDisplay, getHITLActions, getWorkerStepIndex). 4 Kanban columns (triage/human/agent/done). Pipeline stepper aligned with backend worker chain (6 steps). 1 new file, 7 modified. TypeScript clean, build clean.

Two-phase TD→GA→CE pipeline split. Split run_td_to_content_pipeline into run_td_gap_analysis_only (Phase 1: GA with SSE instrumentation, ga_step_start/ga_step_complete at all 8 S-steps) and run_td_content_production_only (Phase 2: CE from pre-computed GA). 3 new BriefPipelineStatus (gap_analysis_pending/gap_analysis/gap_analysis_complete). GA-phase Redis state layer (ta-{id} keys in pipeline_state:{slug} hash). DbContentDataService.get_briefs() merges GA cards before DB briefs. 2 new runner tasks, 2 new endpoints (POST /from-topics/gap-analysis, POST /from-topics/start-production). TopicContentProductionRequest schema. Alembic 0032. Frontend: types+adapter+api+hooks+visual components for GA phase (8-step stepper, 'Start Production' CTA). Planner handleApprove wires to GA pipeline. 49 new tests. Codex gpt-5.3-codex audit: 7 findings fixed (H1-H4, M1-M2). 85 tests passing. Build clean.

completed.task: Two-phase TD→GA→CE pipeline split — GA-only + CE-only with SSE, Redis state, frontend integration

details.architecture: Two separate tasks (GA-only + CE-only), each with own task_id/semaphore/SSE stream. GA completes with ga_run_id in result; CE receives ga_run_id as input.
details.backend_new_statuses: BriefPipelineStatus: gap_analysis_pending, gap_analysis, gap_analysis_complete. TopicAssignmentStatus: gap_analysis_complete.
details.backend_ga_state: GA-phase cards use ta-{uuid} keys in pipeline_state:{slug} Redis Hash. __tid: for task_id, __meta: for JSON metadata (title, cluster, priority, buyer_stage, ga_run_id). No JSON file fallback.
details.backend_sse: ga_step_start/ga_step_complete events at all 8 S-step boundaries in run_topic_scoped_gap_analysis. Each includes step, name, step_num, total_steps.
details.frontend_flow: Planner Approve → POST gap-analysis → card in Queue → SSE GA progress → gap_analysis_complete → user clicks Start Production → POST start-production → normal CE flow
details.audit_fixes: H1: ga_step_complete payload (step_num/total_steps). H2: CancelledError cleanup. H3: GA cleanup moved to post-CE-success. H4: effectiveSlug wired through card. M1: multi-card GA progress. M2: completed/failed SSE aliases.
